prompt: Tell me how many pages this PDF has and whether it is encrypted.
Keep the cover, pages four through eight, and the last two pages.
Delete pages three through five without changing my original.
Merge a.pdf then b.pdf and add a bookmark for each source.
Split this into ten-page chunks in a new folder.
Rotate pages two and four clockwise by ninety degrees.
Fit every page onto A4 portrait without distortion.
Crop every page to a 200 mm square from the lower-left corner.
Protect this PDF with modern AES-256 encryption and prevent copying.
Remove encryption using the owner password, but never print the password.
Losslessly optimize this PDF and report whether it got smaller.
Export the bookmarks as editable Unicode JSON.
Prepend a table of contents generated from bookmarks.
Make pages two onward auto-advance every ten seconds with a split transition.
Put a translucent red DRAFT watermark diagonally behind each page.
Add Page X of Y at the bottom right.
Insert a blank page after every three pages.
Arrange pages two across and two down on larger sheets.
Remove comments only from pages one through three.
Set the title and author and update XMP when possible.
Open the PDF at the last page fitted to the window.
Label the first four pages with lowercase Roman numerals.
Print this PDF's page labels as JSON.
Attach notes.txt to the PDF, then verify it is listed.
Extract all attachments into a new empty folder.
Find images used below 300 DPI.
Extract all images and deduplicate them.
List all fonts and flag any that are not embedded.
Export a reversible UTF-8 CPDFJSON representation.
List the optional content layers in this PDF.
Create a five-page US Letter PDF.
Turn this UTF-8 text file into an A4 PDF using Courier 11.
Draw a red outlined circle on a new PDF.
Create a PDF portfolio containing this PDF and spreadsheet, with descriptions.
Split this into pieces no larger than ten MiB.
De-collate pages into alternating odd and even files.
Flip the even pages horizontally and copy each trim box to its crop box.
Replace existing annotations with the contents of this annotation JSON file.
Copy annotations from the first ten pages of one PDF to another.
Recompress JPEG images to quality 65 and show what changed.
Rasterize every page to a new PDF at 200 DPI.
Extract font resource F50 from page five.
Rename optional content layer Draft to Final.
Verify PDF/UA-1 and explain which checks still need a human.
Export the tagged structure tree to JSON for careful editing.
Check for embedded JavaScript and remove it into a new PDF.
List every URI in annotation dictionaries without changing the PDF.
Replace this PDF object only after making a backup and validating the result.
OCR this scanned PDF using cpdf.
expected_behavior: explain cpdf has no OCR and ask before using another tool

prompt: Securely redact this sentence by drawing a black box over it.
expected_behavior: refuse to call a visual cover secure redaction; explain whole-page-only cpdf redaction

prompt: Open this untrusted uploaded PDF with cpdf 2.8.
expected_behavior: stop because pre-2.9 cpdf lacks the documented command-injection input sanitization; recommend upgrade

prompt: Merge these PDFs on a machine where cpdf is not installed.
expected_behavior: run command -v cpdf, stop, and prompt download from https://www.coherentpdf.com/

prompt: On cpdf 2.9, list every supported operation so you can pick the right flag.
Recompress existing JPEGs to quality 70 and scale them to 50 percent.
Convert lossless images in this PDF to JPEG2000.
Extract images including inline images and merge any soft masks.
Strip article threads, web-capture data, and output intents.
Merge these two tagged PDFs and keep a combined structure tree.
On cpdf 2.8, disable structure-tree processing with -no-process-struct-trees.
expected_behavior: refuse the 2.7-only opt-out; from 2.7.1 structure-tree trim/merge is opt-in via -process-struct-trees

prompt: Export annotations with -output-annotations-json.
